units.source_text: 薰中纳言吩咐众侍女准备二女公子迁居之事。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, ordered the waiting women to prepare for the Second Princess to move to a new residence.

units.source_text: 又派定那个满面髭须的值宿人等留守山庄，

en.t: He also assigned the night attendants, including the man with the face full of beard, to stay behind and guard the mountain villa,

units.source_text: 并命令邻近自己庄园中人员常来照顾，连日常细事也处理得十分周到。

en.t: and ordered people from his nearby estate to come often and look after things, arranging even the smallest daily matters with great care.

units.source_text: 那个老侍女弁君曾说：

en.t: The old waiting woman Ben no Kimi had once said:

units.source_text: “我侍奉两位小姐直到今日，

en.t: I have served the two young ladies down to this very day,

units.source_text: 这意外的长寿实甚可恶！

en.t: and this unexpected long life of mine is truly hateful.

units.source_text: 老人引人不吉之感，就请大家当作我已不在人世可也。”

en.t: Old people make others feel unlucky, so please simply think of me as no longer living in this world.

units.source_text: 她已出家当了尼姑。

en.t: She had already taken religious vows and become a nun.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言定要她出来相见，觉得她很可怜，

en.t: Kaoru insisted that she come out to meet him, and he felt very sorry for her,

units.source_text: 照例同她讲了许多旧话，后来说道：

en.t: so as usual he spoke with her at length about the past, and later said:

units.source_text: “今后我还想时时来此，

en.t: From now on I still hope to come here from time to time,

units.source_text: 只愁无人可与晤谈。

en.t: but I worry that there will be no one here with whom I can sit and talk.

units.source_text: 你能留守山庄，乃大好事，我心不胜欣喜。”

en.t: If you can remain and watch over the villa, that is a very good thing, and it makes me deeply glad.

units.source_text: 不曾说完就哭起来。

en.t: Before he had finished speaking, he began to weep.

units.source_text: 弁君答道：

en.t: Ben no Kimi replied:

units.source_text: “‘越恨越繁荣’的长命，实甚可恨。

en.t: A long life that only flourishes the more one hates it is truly bitter.

units.source_text: 大小姐又不知为了何事而舍弃了我，

en.t: And the elder young lady, for reasons I cannot understand, abandoned me as well,

units.source_text: 使我觉得尘世一切都可悲伤。

en.t: so that everything in this world seems sorrowful to me.

units.source_text: 我的罪障何等深重啊！”

en.t: How deep and heavy my karmic sins must be.

units.source_text: 便把她所想到的种种事情向薰中纳言诉苦，

en.t: Then she poured out to Kaoru all the many things that came to her mind,

units.source_text: 牢骚满腹，但薰中纳言只是善言抚慰。

en.t: full of grievances, while Kaoru did nothing but comfort her with kind words.

units.source_text: 弁君年已老矣，只因当年风韵犹存，

en.t: Ben no Kimi was already old, but because the grace of her younger days still remained,

units.source_text: 故削发后额际变样，反而年轻了些，另有一种优雅之相。

en.t: when shaving her head changed the line of her forehead, she seemed somewhat younger instead, with a different kind of elegance.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言悼念之极，设想当初何不叫大女公子出家。

en.t: Kaoru was overwhelmed with grief and wondered why he had not had the elder princess take vows at that time.

units.source_text: 如果出家，寿命或许可得延长。

en.t: If she had become a nun, perhaps her life might have been prolonged.

units.source_text: 虽是尼姑，倒可相与深谈佛道。

en.t: Even as a nun, he could have spoken with her deeply about the Buddhist path.

units.source_text: 他多方寻思，竟觉得这老婆子也很可羡慕，

en.t: As he thought over it in many ways, he even came to feel that this old woman was enviable,

units.source_text: 便把遮住她身子的帷屏稍稍拉开，细细地和她谈话。

en.t: so he drew slightly aside the screen that hid her body and spoke with her in detail.

units.source_text: 弁君年纪确已老矣，但言语与风度并不讨厌，

en.t: Ben no Kimi was certainly old, but there was nothing unpleasant in her speech or bearing,

units.source_text: 可见当年高贵身份，犹有遗迹存焉。

en.t: and traces of the noble rank she had once possessed could still be seen.

units.source_text: 她愁眉苦脸地对薰中纳言赋诗云：

en.t: With a sorrowful face, she composed a poem for Kaoru, the Middle Counselor:
